Yamato: "...Oh, it looks like Fain's having Garyud
train him."
Fain: "Haaaaah!!"
Garyud: "Hmph!"
Fain: "I-I yield!"
Garyud: "Mm. Your sword strokes are good.
But if you only attack, you can be overpowered
as you just were. If you insist on nothing but offense,
any reasonably skilled opponent will defeat you.
Still, your swordsmanship combines formal training and your own style,
and I can see the strengths of both. First, watch your opponent's movements.
With your skill, you should be able to spot an opening.
Concentrate on that single instant and strike.
That, too, is a perfectly sound strategy."
Fain: "Y-Yes, sir! O-One more bout!"
Touya: "He sure keeps at it... And that Garyud guy
looks like he's just casually brushing him aside."
Ciel: "...Of course. The only person who can match Father
with a sword is someone who also bears the title 'Sword Radiance,'
Marie Christil."
Touya: "Hm? Oh..."
Ciel: "We haven't introduced ourselves yet, have we?
I am Ciel Ren Vratzen, one of York's Three Sword Knights.
A pleasure to make your acquaintance."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... I'm Touya Kazami. Nice to meet you."
Yamato: "Come to think of it, Ciel, you're Garyud's
daughter, aren't you, meow?"
Ciel: "Yes."
Touya: "Is he really that amazing?"
Ciel: "You should learn a little more. Father is one of those
who bears the title 'Sword Radiance,' the mark of the finest knights
in this world. And 'Sword Radiance' is the highest honor,
awarded to no more than three people.
But at present, only Father and Christil hold it,
and the third 'Sword Radiance' seat remains vacant."
Touya: "Three people in the whole world...? Doesn't that make him
unbelievably amazing?"
Ciel: "That's what I've been telling you. What's more,
he holds the rank of 'Phantom Saint,' the highest a knight can attain.
Father is the greatest knight in both name and deed.
I'm proud to be Father's daughter.
And I believe it's my duty to support him."
Touya: "You really respect him."
Ciel: "Yes. More than any other man in the world."
Touya: "O-Oh..."
Ciel: "But it's unusual for Father to train someone.
His strikes certainly are good, though..."
Touya: "His? Hmm. Well, he does seem to be holding his own
crossing swords with him..."
Ciel: "That knight Fain is rough around the edges, but there's something special
in him. If he keeps training and polishing his skills,
he'll eventually become a knight who can shoulder Agarthia's future."
Touya: "So he isn't just some hot-blooded idiot..."
Fain: "You there! You just insulted me, didn't you?!"
Touya: "Gah! You heard me from this far away?!"
Fain: "Excuse me, sir!"
Fain: "If you have something to say, say it clearly!"
Touya: "You're just a hot-blooded idiot."
Fain: "Urgh... When you put it that bluntly..."
Ciel: "You've misunderstood. He was complimenting you.
He said, 'So he isn't just some hot-blooded idiot.'"
Fain: "Huh...? Really?"
Touya: "Well, yeah, I did say that."
Fain: "Oh! You've finally recognized my ability!
You're a bit late, but I'll forgive you!
Dahahahaha!"
Touya: "..."
Garyud: "Fain. You certainly have exceptional talent.
I acknowledge that too.
But while modesty can box you in,
arrogance will destroy you. As you are now,
you'll soon come up against your limits."
Fain: "What?! Y-Yes, sir! I'll be careful!"
Garyud: "Mm. That concludes today's training."
Fain: "Thank you very much!"
Garyud: "Mm."
Ciel: "Oh, Father!"
Fain: "Well, I'll be going too. See you."
Yamato: "Shall we go too?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "This room's awfully cluttered, meow."
Touya: "Oh..."
Yamato: "What's wrong?"
Touya: "Someone's asleep."
Yamato: "Oh, you're right... Wait, isn't that Celica, meow?"
Touya: "Looks like it..."
Celica: "Mmm..."
Touya: "..."
Yamato: "Hmm, so this is what they mean by 'unguarded.'"
Celica: "Mmm... Achoo."
Yamato: "Oh, dear. Sleeping somewhere without air conditioning,
and dressed so lightly too...
If only we had a blanket..."
Touya: "..."
Fetch a blanket from my room.
Leave quietly.
Touya: "All right, I'll go get something to cover her with."
Yamato: "Get something? From where?"
Touya: "My room. I'll be back."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Touya: "Huff, huff, huff... Why am I trying
so hard...?"
Touya: "...Anyway, I'd better not think about anything else..."
Touya: "Right, a blanket, a blanket... There."
Yamato: "Oh, Touya. That was quick."
Touya: "Huff, huff... I'm exhausted...
F-First, I'll put this over her... There we go."
Yamato: "Yes, yes. That should do it..."
Celica: "..."
Yamato: "Well, we shouldn't wake her. Let's get going, meow."
Touya: "Yeah."
Celica: "Ugh... Mmm... Huh...?
...Oh, right, I fell asleep...!!"
Touya: "H-Hey..."
Yamato: "...G-Good morning, Celica..."
Celica: "(Inhaaaale)"
Touya: "Th-There's an explanation for this..."
Celica: "Aaaaaaah!!"
Touya: "Whoa! S-Sorry!"
Yamato: "Th-That startled me..."
Fain: "Oh, Touya! What's happened?!
I definitely heard the princess scream just now..."
Touya: "No, it's nothing."
Fain: "It makes no sense for her to scream
if nothing's wrong. Where is the princess?"
Yamato: "She's in there, but right now..."
Fain: "Right!"
Yamato: "...You'd better not..."
Fain: "Oh! P-Princess, the way you're dressed!"
Celica: "Ah! You're in on it too?!"
Fain: "Huh? Wh-What on earth are you..."
Celica: "Just get ooout!"
Fain: "U-Urgh..."
Yamato: "I did try to tell you..."
Celica: "..."
Yamato: "Oh, h-hello."
Celica: "...Well?"
Touya: "What do you mean, 'well'...? Right?"
Fain: "D-Don't turn to me..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Well, now that I've confirmed the princess is safe,
I'll take my leave... Goodbye!"
Yamato: "Oh, he ran away..."
Celica: "...Well, I don't think you came here to peep,
but I am a girl, you know."
Touya: "Yeah, sorry. But I never thought you'd be sleeping
in a place like that..."
Celica: "Well, let's just say we were both careless
this time."
Yamato: "That's a relief, huh, Touya?"
Celica: "All right, that's the end of that.
Oh, right, I often fall asleep here,
<FC:3C:3E><FC:04:3C:1C:F0> so I'd appreciate it if you'd be a little more careful next time."
Touya: "Yeah, got it. I'll be careful."
Celica: "See you later."
